fields.statement: Built the branch head (9a4dfa5d) into a scratch binary and drove it by hand in a scratch git repo with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset. add anchor with symbol=Keep (func), T.M (pointer-receiver method) and B (const in a grouped block) stored sha256 values that match sha256sum of exactly the declaration bytes, doc comment excluded; without symbol, notes.md got sha256sum of the file; an explicit fingerprint=sha256:abc was kept as given; set cb --field symbol=A recomputed it to sha256 of 'A = 1'. A missing path, a missing symbol and a symbol on a .md file were each refused with exit 2 and a next line.

Built the branch head (9a4dfa5d) into a scratch binary and drove it by hand in a scratch git repo with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset. With a valid anchor, check printed ok. After renaming the anchored func Keep, check exited 1 with 'fail anchor pkg/p.go: anchor pin (implements thing): symbol Keep of pkg/p.go is gone'. After moving the file away, it printed a 'path pkg/p.go is gone' fail for each of the three anchors on that file, naming the capability, or 'implements nothing' when unlinked. Once the file was restored, check was clean again.

Built the branch head (9a4dfa5d) into a scratch binary and drove it by hand in a scratch git repo with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset. After the anchored function's body changed, check exited 0 with one warn naming anchor pin and capability thing, and with next 'rhiza anchor refresh pin'. Editing only the doc comment above the declaration added no finding. Appending to a whole-file-anchored notes.md gave a 'file notes.md changed' warn. go test ./internal/check passes.

Built the branch head (9a4dfa5d) into a scratch binary and drove it by hand in a scratch git repo with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset. In a change set, anchor refresh pin --dry-run --json and api call anchor.refresh --dry-run printed identical bytes, and the dry runs left the .rhiza file count unchanged. A real refresh wrote the new fingerprint (previous to new), and a second refresh said it was unchanged and wrote nothing. A gone symbol and a gone path were each refused with exit 2 and a next line. After propose, accept, land and render, check had no finding for pin. The anchor-refresh, describe-golden and other anchor scripts pass.
